info.title: Billing events
info.description:
Events the billing service publishes about invoices.

Consumers must: (1) deduplicate on eventId, because delivery is at-least-once; (2) ignore fields they do not recognise; (3) drop an event whose invoiceRevision is lower than the last one applied for that invoice; (4) never depend on order across different invoices.

Versioning: within a version only optional fields are added. A breaking change (rename, removal, type or meaning change, a new required field) ships as a new event version on a new channel, published alongside the old one until the old one's x-sunset date.

production.description: Placeholder host; replace with the real bootstrap servers.

invoiceLifecycleV1.description: Every state change of an invoice, in the order it happened for that invoice.
invoiceLifecycleV1.x-ordering: Ordered per invoiceId: all events for one invoice arrive in the order billing published them. No order across invoices and no global order. Retries can redeliver an earlier event; consumers compare invoiceRevision.
invoiceLifecycleV1.x-delivery: at-least-once; duplicates happen on producer retry and consumer rebalance
invoiceLifecycleV1.x-replay: Consumers can reset their offset to any point inside the retention window.
invoiceLifecycleV1.x-dead-letter: A consumer moves a message it cannot process after 5 attempts to <consumer>.billing.invoice-lifecycle.v1.dlq; the consuming team owns and watches its own DLQ.

InvoiceIssued.name: InvoiceIssued
InvoiceIssued.title: Invoice issued
InvoiceIssued.summary: An invoice was issued to a customer.
InvoiceIssued.description: Event-carried state: the full invoice as issued, so consumers need no call back to billing.

InvoicePaid.name: InvoicePaid
InvoicePaid.title: Invoice paid
InvoicePaid.summary: An invoice was paid in full.
InvoicePaid.description: Notification: ids and the amount paid only; fetch the invoice from the billing API for anything else.

invoiceRevision.description: Increases by 1 on every change to this invoice.

eventId.description: Unique per event; the same on every redelivery. Consumers deduplicate on it.

eventType.description: Past-tense event name; one per message schema.

eventVersion.description: Major version of this event type's schema.

occurredAt.description: When the fact happened, UTC, RFC 3339 with Z.

producer.description: The service that owns the fact.

correlationId.description: Shared by every event and request in one business flow.

causationId.description: eventId (or request id) of what directly caused this event.

customerId.description: Opaque id; no name or contact details on the event.
